Info

Vector CAD rendering engine for trajectory paths, waypoint markers, and selection highlights.

class scarajectory.infrastructure.gui.canvas.canvas_trajectory_renderer.CanvasTrajectoryRenderer[source]¶

Bases: object

Renders trajectory polylines, waypoint markers, coordinate labels, and selection rings.

It defines:

methods:
draw_trajectory - Renders trajectory path lines, waypoint node markers and selection rings.
_draw_nodes - Renders waypoint circle markers and point labels.
classmethod draw_trajectory(canvas: Canvas, vp: ViewportTransform, plan: TrajectoryPlan, validator: ITrajectoryValidator) → None[source]¶

Renders trajectory path lines, waypoint node markers and selection rings.

Parameters:

  • canvas – Target Tkinter canvas widget.

  • vp – ViewportTransform instance.

  • plan – Active TrajectoryPlan instance.

  • validator – ITrajectoryValidator instance.
